column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
#   an assertion the manifest lists that the base run never reached counts as failed, by its shortfall
# A base of - means no complete red run was made: none was possible, the
# suite stopped before reached or reached no assertion, or tests/red itself
# was stopped; its stdout said which unless it was the one stopped.
# Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a checkout with no github remote is refused with exactly one refused row
a dry run on an escaping tree leaves says.log byte for byte as it found it
a real run refused for blockers of two kinds records one refused row per kind
a real run refused for two escapes of one kind records exactly one refused row
a self-governed merge is told its head commit by --match-head-commit too
a self-governed repository refused for a set FELIX_KERNEL records exactly one refused row
an argument felix merge cannot honour is recorded as exactly one refused row
and a dry run on an escaping tree writes no escalated row
and adds, removes or changes no file under the project's memory
and each of those refused rows carries the branch and the session
and is handed a non-empty --subject and --body
and its Felix-Gate trailer is the tree id the receipt was recorded for
and its Felix-Judge trailer is main's declared version at the base ref's full sha
and its subject and body carry no ci skip marker though every commit does
and neither subject nor body carries a ci skip marker though every commit does
and that refused row begins with the branch and the kind and carries the session
and that row begins with the checked-out branch and carries the session
and the FELIX_KERNEL refusal row carries the branch and the session
and the body ends in Felix-Gate and Felix-Judge trailers naming the receipt's tree
and the no-remote refusal row carries the branch and the session
gh pr merge is told the head commit the checkout has, by --match-head-commit
